  war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_sway_desc: "迫使这场干涉的发动国接受羞辱。"
+ nesnd_native_khanate.4.t: "干涉前的毁约"
+ nesnd_native_khanate.4.d: "[SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_khanate_opponent').GetName]已退出与汗国之间含有联盟或防御协定条款的条约，为干涉清除障碍。若同一份条约还载有贸易或其他约定，那些条款也随之终止；毁约的外交代价仍由退出国承担。两国与第三国的条约不在此次退出之列。"
+ nesnd_native_khanate.4.a: "战争先从盟约的破裂开始。"
*** End Patch

  war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation: "Humiliate the Intervener: [WAR_GOAL_DRAFT.GetTarget.GetName]"
  war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_desc: "Force the government responsible for this intervention to accept humiliation."
  war_goal_wg_nesnd_khanate_humiliation_sway_desc: "Force the government responsible for this intervention to accept humiliation."
+ nesnd_native_khanate.4.t: "Broken Treaties Before Intervention"
+ nesnd_native_khanate.4.d: "[SCOPE.sCountry('nesnd_khanate_opponent').GetName] has withdrawn from treaties with the khanate containing an alliance or defensive pact, clearing the way for intervention. Any trade or other provisions in the same treaties end with them. The withdrawing country bears the diplomatic cost of breaking its word. Neither country's treaties with third powers are included."
+ nesnd_native_khanate.4.a: "The war begins with a broken promise."
